# **Does Health Net Cover Doulas in California? 2026 Guide**


Yes. Most Health Net members in California have coverage for doula care, and most Loula patients pay $0 out of pocket. You don’t need a referral to get started, and you get to choose your own doula.


Coverage works a little differently depending on the type of Health Net plan you have. Health Net Medi-Cal members have doula care as a covered benefit, and Health Net’s Covered California (marketplace) plans include doula care too. Some other plans, like employer or self-funded plans, can vary.


Here’s what you need to know about using your Health Net doula benefit in 2026.


#### **The short version**


If you have Health Net in California, there’s a good chance your doula care is covered.


Health Net Medi-Cal plans include coverage for doula care during pregnancy, birth, and postpartum. Health Net’s Covered California marketplace plans cover doula care as well. For most Loula patients, that means $0 out of pocket.


The main thing to confirm is your specific plan. Coverage under some plans, like employer-sponsored or self-funded plans, can vary. When you check your coverage through Loula, we’ll let you know what your plan includes before care begins.


#### **What does a doula actually do?**


A doula provides nonmedical support before, during, and after birth. They can help you understand your options, prepare for labor, support you physically and emotionally during birth, and be there as you recover and adjust postpartum.


Unlike your doctor or midwife, your doula’s focus is consistent, one-on-one support for you. Think of it as having someone in your corner who knows how this works and whose focus is you.


If you want a fuller picture of what that support looks like at each stage, here’s[what a doula does before, during, and after birth](https://joinloula.com/blog/what-does-a-doula-do) .


#### **Why does Health Net cover doula care?**


Research has linked doula support with better maternal health outcomes. One recent study of Medicaid enrollees found a 47% lower risk of delivering by C-section and a 29% lower risk of preterm birth among people with doula support.


California has also expanded access to doula care in recent years, including adding doula services as a Medi-Cal benefit in 2023. Because Health Net is one of California’s Medi-Cal managed care plans, Health Net Medi-Cal members have access to that benefit, and Health Net extends doula coverage to its Covered California marketplace plans too.


#### **What’s covered?**


For most Health Net members in California, covered doula care includes:


- One initial visit
- Up to eight additional visits that can be used before or after birth
- Support throughout labor and delivery
- Up to two extended three-hour postpartum visits
- Support through pregnancy loss, including miscarriage, stillbirth, and abortion


Additional postpartum visits may also be covered with a provider’s recommendation.


Coverage details can vary by plan, especially for employer-sponsored or self-funded plans, so it’s worth confirming what your specific plan includes. Loula can do that for you before care begins.


#### **What’s not covered?**


Insurance covers eligible doula support, but some additional services doulas may offer aren’t part of the covered benefit.


Services like massage, birth photography, placenta encapsulation, and belly binding generally aren’t covered. Some doulas offer these services separately if you’re interested in them.


#### **Health Net Medi-Cal vs. Health Net marketplace plans**


Health Net offers a few different kinds of plans in California, and doula coverage looks a little different across them.


**Health Net Medi-Cal.** Doula care is a covered Medi-Cal benefit. Health Net offers Medi-Cal coverage in counties across California. If you’re a Health Net Medi-Cal member, you have access to covered doula care during pregnancy, birth, and postpartum.


**Health Net Covered California (marketplace) plans.** Health Net’s marketplace plans, offered through Covered California, include doula care at no cost to members who are pregnant or were pregnant within the past year.


**Employer and self-funded plans.** Coverage under these plans can vary. Some include doula care and some don’t, so it’s best to confirm your specific benefits.


Not sure which kind of plan you have? That’s one of the things Loula checks when we verify your coverage.


#### **Do you need a referral?**


No. You don’t need a referral from your Health Net doctor to start working with a doula.


Members with the Medi-Cal doula benefit are covered by a statewide standing recommendation for doula services, so you don’t need to get a separate recommendation before getting started. Additional postpartum visits beyond the standard benefit may require a provider’s recommendation.


#### **What will it cost you?**


For most Loula patients, $0 out of pocket.


Most Loula patients with Health Net pay nothing out of pocket for covered doula care, whether they’re on a Health Net Medi-Cal plan or a Health Net marketplace plan.


Costs can vary for some plans, like employer-sponsored or self-funded plans. Loula verifies your coverage before care begins, so you’ll know what’s covered before getting started.

#### **Frequently asked questions**


**Does Health Net cover doulas in California?** Yes. Most Health Net members in California have coverage for doula care, and most Loula patients pay $0 out of pocket. Health Net Medi-Cal plans and Health Net’s Covered California marketplace plans include doula care. Coverage under some plans, like employer or self-funded plans, can vary.


**Is there a copay for a Health Net doula?** Most Loula patients with Health Net pay $0 out of pocket for covered doula care. Costs can vary for some plans, so coverage should be confirmed before care begins. Loula verifies your coverage for you.


**Does Health Net Medi-Cal cover doulas?** Yes. Doula care is a covered benefit for Health Net Medi-Cal members, including support during pregnancy, birth, and postpartum.


**Do you need a referral for a doula with Health Net?** No. You don’t need a referral to get started. Members with the Medi-Cal doula benefit are covered by a statewide standing recommendation for doula services.


**How many doula visits does Health Net cover?** For most Health Net members, coverage includes an initial visit, up to eight additional prenatal or postpartum visits, labor and delivery support, and two extended postpartum visits. Additional postpartum visits may be covered with a provider’s recommendation. Coverage can vary for some plans.


**Does Health Net cover a doula for miscarriage or pregnancy loss?** Yes. Covered doula care can include support through miscarriage, stillbirth, and abortion.


**Can you pick your own doula with Health Net?** Yes. You can choose your own doula as long as they meet the requirements of your Health Net plan. Loula can help you find a doula who works with your plan, is available around your due date, and fits what matters to you.


**What if I’m not sure which Health Net plan I have?** That’s common, and it’s one of the things Loula checks for you. When you check your coverage through Loula, we’ll confirm what your specific Health Net plan covers before care begins.\`
